question: Which of the following temples is also known as "Taj Mahal of the South"?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meenakshi Temple, Madurai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Meenakshi Temple**, also known as the **Meenakshi Amman Temple**, is located in **Madurai, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is renowned for its **architectural grandeur** and is often referred to as the **"Taj Mahal of the South"** due to its majestic beauty and intricate design.
 
• This temple is dedicated to **Goddess Meenakshi** (an avatar of Goddess Parvati) and her consort **Sundareswarar** (an avatar of Lord Shiva).
 
• The temple complex is an exquisite example of **Dravidian architecture**, featuring **14 gopurams (gateway towers)**, the tallest of which is about **170 feet**.
